rationale: 1993 JNNP study of acute levodopa withdrawal in nine patients with motor fluctuations. Abstract reports global motor-disability deterioration and one withdrawal due to confusion/hallucinations; it does not give symptom-specific rigidity, tremor, bradykinesia, or fall results. Pain/anxiety/apathy are not outcomes. Frozen pair: fresh sage and pain severity.
1996 survey of 1,227 decedents estimates dementia prevalence/correlates; abstract reports dementia and incontinence, not pain or falls. Frozen pair: fresh sage and pain severity.
